text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 1,300 families are to receive a total of 25 million dinars in loans from Housing Ministry.
- Kuwait raises about 600 million dinars from its privatisation plan launched in 1994, Kuwaiti official says.
- Bahrain's State Security Court resumes trial of Qatari man and woman on charges of spying for Doha. The court decided to adjourn the case until December 18.
- Bahrain and Morocco sign agreement on legal and judicial cooperation in trade and civil affairs.
